name: B10-0070/2024 (Renew) – The democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns new Georgian laws on "foreign influence" and "family values", and the scrapping of gender quotas for election lists. It asks Georgia to repeal these laws, restore the quotas, and fix how its election commission is formed. It also asks the European Union to freeze funding to Georgia's government until the laws are repealed, and to consider sanctions on Georgian officials.

- Georgia must repeal two laws and restore gender quotas in elections.
- European Union funding to Georgia's government should be frozen until then.
- European Union should consider sanctions on Georgian officials; elections are on 26 October 2024.
